name: subroutine
description: Agent-native task management for your life, your projects and your team.

plugins.name: subroutine
plugins.description: Give Claude a shared, durable task list: file work, find what is ready, record what happened, and leave the next session something to read. This one runs Subroutine as a program on your own machine, so it works in Claude Code and the desktop apps and not on the web. The only thing to install first is 'uv' — the plugin fetches Subroutine itself on first use, and keeps a copy you already installed if you have one. If your work lives on a server somebody else runs, install 'subroutine-remote' instead.

plugins.name: subroutine-remote
plugins.description: The same shared task list, against a Subroutine instance somebody else runs. Paste the address and the token you were given and you are working — nothing to install and no configuration file to edit. Your editor connects from this machine, so a server on your own network or behind a VPN works as readily as a public one. It is a Claude Code plugin, so it runs and is configured wherever those run. A hosted surface that adds servers as connectors instead — claude.ai, and the apps that offer an 'Add custom connector' dialog — cannot use it: a connector authenticates with OAuth, which Subroutine does not offer yet, so there is nowhere to put the token you were given. Install 'subroutine' if the work lives on this machine.
